original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independent exact replay of idle-axis redistribution on all 112 T740 port recipes for owner replica zero: test every eligible one-axis move among children (8,10,12,13); test common-axis paired transfers from (8,10) to (12,13) and in reverse; replay the source-pinned PR3184 replica-0/port-0 star; derive own-axis isolation for all same-centre stars in this four-child class; and use OR-Tools CP-SAT to optimize assignments of 192 residual-axis tokens under hosted-axis and pairwise-orthogonality constraints with rank cap 51.
scope_change_reason: PR3187 gives an exact counterexample to PR3184’s first committed star move. After the single and paired census, the remaining matched-swap/longer-cycle question is naturally an assignment problem: an incoming vector may become feasible if a nonorthogonal destination vector leaves at the same time. OR-Tools is used only for candidate nomination and a local moment objective; exact replay remains the physical acceptance test. The all-single census also yields a scoped isolation proof for same-centre stars, and an independently implemented replay checks the actual pinned PR3184 replica-0/port-0 move. The user explicitly favored OR-Tools for optimization.
bottleneck_link: A better rank histogram changes the moment only if the exact hosted eight-stream physical operator is preserved. Every eligible one-axis transfer fails, which isolates any nonempty same-centre star built from an orthonormal donor basis in the audited owner-0 slice. CP-SAT additionally finds the most uneven profile in a relaxed four-child assignment model; neither result is a new provider moment or κ.
stop_rule: Authenticate the complete T740 fill, PR3184 star artifact and all 112 recipes; verify positive baseline controls; enumerate eligible single-axis and paired transfers; replay PR3184’s actual replica-0/port-0 star at each moved axis; use the complete single-axis census to isolate the same-centre star family; for each port solve the residual-axis assignment model to optimality for the local moment surrogate and minimum move count, then replay the nominated candidate on the recorded character set. Do not claim all assignments at the optimal rank profile or multi-donor cycles fail, and do not generalize to other child pairs or replicas.
evidence: verify.py authenticates the PR3148 T740 payload SHA256 8f4d6965…e00 and the complete PR3184 STAR-MOVES payload from head 6faefe19f592220c16722a6682c22c8fbccd4bb4. It checks the baseline on 147 modes for port 0 plus the zero-character identity for all ports; all 21,504 eligible single-axis candidates and 5,376 paired candidates change the exact Gaussian-integer stream matrix at their own Fourier character. The moved axes in a same-centre star are a subset of one orthonormal donor basis, so any nonempty such star is isolated by one rejected single move on each audited owner-0 recipe. The actual PR3184 replica-0/port-0 star sends [16,32,64] from child 10 to 12 and [128,256,4096] from 10 to 13; at character 16 its full overlay equals the isolated single move and differs from baseline in three matrix entries. Optional CP-SAT 9.11.4210 solves 112 relaxed rank-assignment models to optimality, each finding [51,51,51,39] from [48,48,48,48] with 12 moves; one minimum-move representative per port fails at character 1, 2 or 32. No new κ, supplier admission, or selected-frontier change.

open_questions.question: Can a multi-donor cycle with nonorthogonal moved axes preserve the full operator and retain enough fully charged moment improvement?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Same-centre stars are isolated by an active moved-axis character, but exchanging axes among multiple donors can couple nonorthogonal phases and evade that argument.
open_questions.first_step: First derive the maximum complete-provider moment improvement allowed by the four-child assignment relaxation. If it can change the decision, add CP-SAT no-good cuts for screened assignments and replay candidates over a complete character quotient or prove a compact exact criterion.
open_questions.blocked_by: The current receipt tests one minimum-move representative per port, not all relaxed assignments; it also does not model the full operator in CP-SAT or charge a surviving overlay through the complete supplier invoice.

open_questions.question: Does any other child/time pair on the T740 schedule admit a physically valid rank-changing transfer?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A different schedule cut could change the rank profile while avoiding this paired obstruction.
open_questions.first_step: Derive exact insertion-to-insertion intertwiners for each candidate pair and use the current port-0 witness as a regression control before optimizing a new profile.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package audits only child pairs (8,10) and (12,13) on owner replica zero; a complete all-pair search is outside its bounded scope.
